description: Two figures dig in a dense tropical forest. The nearer man, shirtless and wearing a brown cloth wrap, bends over a long wooden digging stick driven into dark, crumbly soil. A second, darker figure behind him, also in a cloth wrap, stoops and digs. Large brown tuber roots lie exposed in the earth, with more at the bottom edge, and vines, broad leaves and tall trunks fill the background. There are no machines, buildings or visible text, and the painting fills the whole frame edge to edge in a dark, painterly oil style.
